goal: Stop private transaction broadcasts from leaking node identity through shared networking state
Protect users from transaction origin correlation and deanonymization by network peers
reviewability: Review the logic now because the rebase onto master is mechanical
agreement: Strong support for isolating broadcast state to prevent clearnet transaction linkage (darosior)
Objection to relying on DNS seeds, Tor-only IP peers, and dropping automatic retries (vasild)
Suggests abandoning in-node private broadcast in favor of external tool hooks (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because existing private broadcast shares node state and can deanonymize transaction originators
Fixing this privacy leak removes an active footgun for users broadcasting transactions privately
